A bustling<ref name="Friends AD">{{TOTU|Friends}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> '''city''' was active on a [[Unidentified world (Latts Razzi)|world]] during the [[Imperial Era]].<ref name="Friends" /> During or after [[18 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TalesDate|U2}}</ref> the [[Theelin]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Latts Razzi]] and her companion [[C-21 Highsinger]] hunted and [[Death|killed]] a [[Unidentified four-armed alien|four-armed alien]] in the [[city]].<ref name="Friends" />

{{City-stub}}
